measurementDefinitions.efCommandPair: Provider command start/terminal pair; identity includes trace hash, command ordinal, and occurrence. This is not a SQL statement or round-trip count.
measurementDefinitions.globalPostgreSqlCounts: Successful CommandComplete messages and ReadyForQuery query/Sync cycles are separate capture-wide protocol units.
measurementDefinitions.observationWindow: The 12-second window follows verified requests, permits no retries or extra requests, and explicitly makes no sweep-completion claim.
measurementDefinitions.providerIntervalAttribution: A protocol statement is attributed only through one unique positive backend PID and one unique calibrated provider-attempt interval. Trace-group association is not causal request ownership.
measurementDefinitions.responseBoundary: The boundary is fixture-client response receipt, not server response-finished.
measurementDefinitions.settlement: A point-in-time repeatable-read snapshot proves the state read at that point. A sweep-start marker is an observation marker, not a direct queue read or row-purge count.
measurementDefinitions.temporalAttribution: Same-host monotonic identity and calibration are required; EF classifications use a doubled calibration uncertainty bound. Overlap and uncertainty buckets are retained.
measurementDefinitions.residualQueryNature: Residual EF provider command attempts with no exact operation-method ancestor; table-identifier families are inferred from parser-extracted public identifiers and do not establish caller attribution.
measurementDefinitions.observedOperationPairs: Paired operation metadata observations by HTTP/REST/background trace. These are separate from exact method-ancestor EF command-pair joins and do not count successful or durable state changes.

publicationStatus: finite diagnostic evidence with explicit attribution limits

residualTableIdentifierSourceSupport.checkMethod: Exact literal identifier presence check in C# source at each pinned revision. This supports the public table identifiers and prefix-family labels; it does not prove which method issued a residual command.
